anchor: bottom center, feet end at row 53
body_note: left, top, right, bottom of the rabbit in idle frame 0, rim included, right and bottom exclusive

idle.notes: Ear twitch, then a one pixel breath. head_dy tells the renderer how far to push overlays down per frame.

idle_tap.notes: Idle variant. The right foot taps twice.

idle_watch.notes: Idle variant. He lifts the pocket watch, checks it, and lets it drop.

idle_flick.notes: Idle variant. The left ear flicks twice.

to_listening.notes: Ears rise a pixel at a time, then the eyes widen. Enter transition for listening.

listening.notes: Ears stretch up, eyes widen. Hold the last frame while the kid talks.

from_listening.notes: Ears come down, dip below rest once, and settle. Exit transition for listening.

to_thinking.notes: The thought trail appears, then the empty bubble. Enter transition for thinking.

thinking.notes: He glances at his watch while a pocket watch ticks in a thought bubble. Loop while the model works.

aha.notes: The watch turns into a light bulb and the bubble pops. Play once when the answer is ready, then idle.

to_confused.notes: The left ear folds half way. Enter transition for confused.

confused.notes: One ear flops over and a question mark bobs.

from_confused.notes: The left ear comes back up. Exit transition for confused.

celebrate.notes: Crouch, hop with sparkles, land with a squash, settle. Ears and watch lag the body. Play once.

hop.notes: Travel hop. Loop while moving; move lists the sideways pixels per frame so he only travels in the air.

panic.notes: Oh dear, I'm late. Watch check, gasp, then hold the panic. The player follows it with the hole.

settle.notes: After a hop trip: the last squash eases up, then idle frame 0.

land.notes: Landing after a throw: impact squash, recover, settle on idle frame 0.

wave.notes: He waves with his left ear, twice, then settles. Use for greetings.

to_sleepy.notes: Ears sag, fold half way, then flop as the eyes close. Enter transition for sleepy.

sleepy.notes: Both ears flopped, eyes shut, z's rising. Bedtime and session limits.

from_sleepy.notes: Ears half up with heavy eyes, a stretch above rest, then settle. Exit transition for sleepy.

dragged.notes: Startled and swinging while the kid drags him.

hole_only.notes: An empty rabbit hole opening. Reverse it to close.

hole_open.notes: The hole opens under his feet. Reverse it to close once he has popped out.

dive.notes: He drops into the hole. Reverse it to pop out on the other screen.

hole_wait.notes: Ears poking out of the hole. Loop while the handoff completes.

overlay_blink.notes: Eye patch: half, closed, half. Draw over idle, offset by head_dy.

overlay_mouth.notes: Mouth patch: 0 flat, 1 open, 2 wide, 3 smile. Pick by voice loudness. Offset by head_dy.
